 KNOXVILLE, Tenn. (WCYB) — Tennessee football is entering a pivotal road matchup at Texas A & M on Saturday. 
 However, the Vols will be without defensive lineman Tyree Weathersby and running back Daune Morris for the first time this season. 
 However, the squad has relied on the next-man-up mentality throughout the season. 
 Kickoff is set for 3:00 p.m. in College Station on Saturday.
